description: This file is a PHP unit test class named LocalizationDaoTest that tests the functionality of the LocalizationDao class related to internationalization features, including language searching, counting, retrieval, and translation management within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: LocalizationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies various methods of the LocalizationDao class such as searching, count retrieval, entity fetching, saving, and deleting language and translation data, specific to the HR management system's internationalization features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up the LocalizationDao instance, and populates test data from a fixture YAML file.

methods.name: testSearchLanguages
methods.description: Tests the searchLanguages method with different filter parameters, validating the number and IDs of returned languages.

methods.name: getTestCases
methods.description: Loads test case data from a YAML test cases file for parameterized tests.

methods.name: searchLanguagesDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for searchLanguages tests by retrieving specific test cases from the YAML file.

methods.name: testGetLanguagesCount
methods.description: Validates the getLanguagesCount method by asserting the number of languages returned with different filters.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a language entity by ID, verifying its properties.

methods.name: testSaveI18NLanguage
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new I18NLanguage entity, then verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedTranslations
methods.description: Ensures getNormalizedTranslations returns an array and verifies its size.

methods.name: testGetTranslationsCount
methods.description: Tests counting of translations with various filters to ensure accuracy.

methods.name: testSearchGroups
methods.description: Verifies searchGroups returns the expected array and count of I18N groups.

methods.name: testGetI18NGroupCount
methods.description: Checks the count of I18N groups matching a filter.

methods.name: testDeleteI18NLanguage
methods.description: Tests deletion of language entries by IDs and validates the number of deletions.

methods.name: testGetI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of an I18NError entity by its name.

methods.name: testGetI18NGroupByName
methods.description: Checks retrieval of an I18NGroup by name.

methods.name: testGetLangStringByUnitIdAndGroupID
methods.description: Verifies fetching a language string by unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: testGetLangStringById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a language string by its entity ID.

methods.name: testClearImportErrorsForLangString
methods.description: Tests clearing import errors for specific language strings and verifies the cleanup.

methods.name: testGetImportErrorList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of import error list based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetImportErrorCount
methods.description: Checks the count of import errors according to filter parameters.
